description: Evaluate a strategy against current live market data to check if entry or exit signals are active. It places no orders and opens no positions, but each call records the evaluation: it updates the strategy's last_evaluated_at and evaluation_count and adds an agent_evaluations audit row. Returns the current asset price and any order intents the signals would produce. Use this when the user asks whether a strategy should be entering or exiting right now, or wants to know the live signal state for a specific strategy.
name: evaluate_strategy
